articles.title: Four Astronauts, Four Pixels: The Coolest Blurry Photo Ever!
articles.summary: A telescope in West Virginia snapped a blurry photo of the Artemis II capsule 213,000 miles away. Inside those few pixels? Four real astronauts circling the moon! It might be the farthest-away picture of humans ever taken from Earth.

articles.title: This Air Purifier Cleans Itself—and Your Cat Can Sit on It!
articles.summary: The Dreame FP10 air purifier has a self-cleaning roller that sweeps away pet fur and dust. It's super quiet, doubles as a cat perch, and even has a pet-weighing tray option. Perfect for homes with furry friends!

articles.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2 Is a Huge Hit—Will We Get a Third Movie?
articles.summary: The long-awaited sequel earned $435 million worldwide in just two weeks! With a $100 million budget, it's a massive success. Now fans wonder: will Disney make The Devil Wears Prada 3? The cast might return, but sequels don't always keep the magic.
